sections.heading: What Happens During a Board Up Service Call
sections.body: When you call us for an emergency board up in Washington DC, our team walks you through a straightforward process designed to secure your property as efficiently as possible. After dispatch, a crew arrives on site, assesses the extent of the damage, and clears away any remaining broken glass to eliminate immediate safety hazards. We then measure the affected openings and install heavy-duty boards or protective panels that fit securely and resist further intrusion or weather exposure. Our team also documents the condition of the affected areas, which can be helpful as you work with your insurance carrier or begin planning permanent repairs. Before we leave, we confirm that all openings are fully covered and that no accessible gaps remain.
